{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Select only the two columns we need
subset = penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']]

# Compute correlation (this automatically drops rows with missing values)
correlation = subset.corr().iloc[0, 1]

# Print the correlation value explicitly
print(correlation)"}
